summary: Harden issue-close usage harvest: trusted authors, strict fields, concurrency, issue comments instead of default-branch push.
migration_impact: Downstream repos that relied on automatic `.agentic/COSTS.md` commits from this workflow should aggregate costs via `gh plate costs` or copy rows from `PLATE-USAGE-COST-ROW` comments. Re-import or sync the updated workflow from plate_core template payload.
agent_notes: After upgrading, closing Feature/Question issues still requires a USAGE REPORT block from OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR (or allow-listed bots). Workflow no longer needs contents:write.
